read_pins.read_scope: JSON runtime pins, candidate/case/time, bounds, guide roles/count, quality method, gate count, adoption link, orchestration changes and limits; full cat output was truncated and these fields were then read by JSON projection

runtime_pin_alignment.comparison_basis: Actual LIVE read hashes compared with corresponding declared adoption and frozen runtime hashes; snapshot files and other pinned dependency contents were not separately opened.

limits: Instruction scope review only; no native-quality proof, exact rendered-copy claim, font-file claim, pixel-resolution guarantee, or authorship claim.
No images or current critic output viewed; no native call, render, helper, new test, case, plan, job, or round executed or created.
No empirical scheduling or current completion count checked; frozen worker maximum is a declaration, not proof of actual concurrency.
Only the two audit artifacts in history/final-scope-ab were written; LIVE, README, helpers, cases, plans, jobs, and old history were not edited.
Runtime pin metadata outside the six reviewed LIVE files was read as declarations only; linked files were not opened.
README AB quality pending is expected and does not establish AB performance; later concurrent changes fall outside these read pins.
